title.narrative: Halting the spread of HIV and reversing its impact in Eswatini - Eswatini (01-Oct-2024-30-Sep-2027)

description.narrative: Eswatini, TB/HIV, Coordinating Assembly of Non Governmental Organisation (CANGO)This program has the following goals: Universal access to HIV prevention, care and treatment for all Eswatini. Reduced new HIV, TB and STIs by 90%. The objectives of this program are: To prevent new HIV, TB, viral hepatitis and STIs. To improve the health outcomes of people living with HIV (PLHIV). To reduce HIV-related disparities and health inequalities. To foster collaboration and synergy among all partners and stakeholders to effectively combat the HIV epidemic
